theme_strategy.rationale: High-visibility, tactical look for a fast-paced B2B parts dealership. Avoids eye strain for long data-entry sessions.

rules: Use IBM Plex Mono for all part numbers, quantities, prices, and tabular data to ensure perfect vertical alignment.
Headings must use tight letter spacing (tracking-tight).
Overlines/Labels MUST be Uppercase + Tiny + Wide Spacing (tracking-[0.2em]).
Do not use generic fonts like Inter for headings.

visual enhancers.surfaces: Grid Borders (The 'Technical' Look): Expose the skeleton. border-collapse with border-r border-b border-border/40. Flat solid backgrounds for data clarity.
visual enhancers.textures: Subtle noise overlay on the main background to break absolute digital flatness.
visual enhancers.shadows: Tactical Minimalism. Replace soft shadows with 1px solid strokes or 2px 'Inner Glow' highlights.

grids.dashboard: High Density Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6. Every pixel utilized. Summary col-span-1, Feed/List col-span-1 row-span-2.

layouts.table: Dense tabular layout, 40px condensed row height. Sticky headers and fixed identifier columns (Part Number). Right-align numeric columns.
layouts.spacing: Generous Spacing Philosophy for macro layouts (p-8 to p-12), but dense spacing within data tables (p-2, p-3) for scanability.

components.tables: Shadcn based but stripped of excessive padding. Sticky headers, Zebra striping (bg-white/5 alternating), and row-level action menus.
components.cards: Flat background, 1px subtle border (border-border), no shadow. Hover: Slight lift (-translate-y-1), border color darkens.
components.inputs: Shadcn inputs heavily customized. Flat solid surfaces. Use Sonner for toasts.

motion.interactions: Hover states must explicitly set text color (e.g., hover:bg-slate-900 hover:text-white). Focus states must have HIGHER contrast.
motion.transitions: Use specific properties (transition: transform 0.2s ease, opacity 0.2s ease). NO transition: all.

accessibility.contrast: Text below 18px: 4.5:1. Active/Hover states must have higher contrast. Never use completely transparent backgrounds for overlays or headers.
accessibility.testing: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='order-submit-button').

image_urls.description: Macro shot of motorcycle engine parts. Use as a subtle, low-opacity background imagery for the login screen.
Modern industrial warehouse interior. Use for inventory upload section headers or empty states.

3d libraries.recommendation: Not required. Focus on pure 2D performance and clarity for dense data tables.

instructions_to_main_agent: Build standard React (.js/.jsx) with Tailwind and Shadcn UI primitives. DO NOT use TypeScript (.tsx).
Use Phosphor Icons (`yarn add @phosphor-icons/react`) for dense developer tools look.
Implement the 'Grid Borders' look for tables: Expose the skeleton, make the grid visible.
Data inputs must have warnings for duplicates and previously ordered items. Use `data-testid` on all interactive elements.
Ensure the Landed Price is auto-calculated visually upon entering the global discount.
Include 'Current' and 'Sent' tabs for order management.
For the table: sticky headers, right-align numeric data (prices, quantities), left-align text data (part numbers, descriptions).
Never use fully transparent backgrounds for dropdowns, modals, or fixed headers.
Create a clean mapping UI for inventory upload to match Excel fields.
UNIVERSAL_GUIDELINES_FOR_MAIN_AGENT: Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all).
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable for macro layouts.
NEVER use placeholder URLs or AI assistant Emojis for icons.
